title: Israel Opens Criminal Investigation Into Killings of Hind Rajab and Gaza Medical Workers
summary: Two high-profile cases that had spurred international condemnation of the country’s conduct in Gaza were transferred to the military police. Such investigations have rarely led to convictions.
